lead.en: A service that starts must stop. Three layers of this stack stop the same way in spirit and differently in form: hooks in reverse, a connection drained rather than cut, and a run that waits for an answer it does not have.
lead.zh: 会启动的服务必须会停下。这一栈里的三层，停法的精神相同、形式不同：钩子倒序执行、连接被排空而不是被切断、以及一次运行停在原地等一个它还没有的答案。

foot.zh: 第 07 章 / 共 10 章

text.en: Startup hooks run in the order they were registered; shutdown hooks run backwards. That single rule is enough to make teardown correct if you register each hook beside the thing it opens.
text.zh: 启动钩子按注册顺序执行，关闭钩子倒着来。只要你把每个钩子写在它打开的那个东西旁边，这一条规则就足以让拆解顺序正确。

out: moonapi : open db -> warm cache -> drop cache -> close db
moonrpc : 1 GOAWAY frame naming stream 0, 0 calls still running
moonstate: resumed -> open db -> confirmed "release it"

text.en: The log is the proof: the cache is dropped before the database is closed, because that is the reverse of how they were opened.
text.zh: 日志就是证据：缓存先放下，数据库后关闭 —— 正好是它们被打开的顺序的逆序。

text.en: Cutting a connection loses the calls in flight. A GOAWAY frame names the last stream the server accepted, so a client knows which calls were processed and which are safe to send elsewhere.
text.zh: 直接切断连接会丢掉在途的调用。GOAWAY 帧报出服务器接受的最后一个流，客户端因此知道哪些调用已被处理、哪些可以安全地发到别处。

text.en: The frame count is one, the stream number is what the server last took, and the running calls are what the client must still wait for. Three numbers, and a client can make a decision.
text.zh: 帧数是一，流号是服务器最后接受的那个，还在跑的调用数就是客户端仍要等的东西。三个数字，客户端就能做决定。

text.en: The third way to stop is not stopping at all: a graph reaches a node that needs an answer from outside, and it parks there with everything it has written so far in a checkpoint.
text.zh: 第三种停法其实不是停：图走到一个需要外部答案的节点，就停在原地，把已经写下的东西都留在检查点里。

variants.code:
let done = graph.resume_with(thread, Json("release it"))
  println("moonstate: resumed -> " + done.lines.join(" -> "))

text.en: `Interrupted` is a value, not an exception to be swallowed: the state is on the error, so a caller can log what the run was asking. The answer resumes the same thread — a second graph would not see the checkpoint.
text.zh: `Interrupted` 是一个值，不是拿来吞掉的异常：状态就在错误上，调用方可以记下这次运行在问什么。答案续在同一条线程上 —— 换一张图就看不到那个检查点了。

rows.en: a release order that matches the acquisition order
rows.zh: 与获取顺序相反的释放顺序

rows.en: sending GOAWAY with the last stream
a list of calls that were processed and calls to re-issue
rows.zh: 哪些调用处理过、哪些要重发

rows.en: parking at a node with a checkpoint
rows.zh: 停在节点并留下检查点

rows.en: a question, and a run that continues after it is answered
rows.zh: 一个问题，以及答完之后能续上的运行

text.en: None of the three blocks forever. Each hands the decision to the layer above, which is what makes a stop look like an ordinary code path instead of a timeout.
text.zh: 三者都不会永久阻塞。每一个都把决定交给上面一层 —— 于是「停下」看起来像一条普通代码路径，而不是一次超时。

items.en: Swap the two shutdown hooks and run the example again. The log still reads correctly in reverse — and then tell me which of the two results you would rather debug at three in the morning.
items.zh: 把两个关闭钩子对调，再跑一次。日志按逆序读仍然通顺 —— 然后说说，凌晨三点你更愿意 debug 哪一个结果。

items.en: Ask `goaway` for a stream number lower than the last one accepted. The frame says less than the truth; work out what a client would re-issue that it should not.
items.zh: 让 `goaway` 用一个比最后接受值更小的流号。帧里说的比事实少，想想客户端会因此重发哪些本不该重发的东西。

items.en: Resume the graph twice. The second call finds no checkpoint in that thread; decide whether that should be an error or a no-op, and say why.
items.zh: 把同一张图续跑两次。第二次在那条线程上找不到检查点；判断这该是错误还是空操作，并说出理由。

items.en: Say why shutdown hooks run in reverse, and register a pair correctly.
items.zh: 说出关闭钩子为什么倒序，并正确注册一对钩子。

items.en: Explain what a client learns from a GOAWAY frame.
items.zh: 解释客户端从 GOAWAY 帧里知道了什么。

items.en: Stop a run at a node and continue it from its checkpoint.
items.zh: 让运行停在某个节点，再从检查点继续。

items.en: Pick the right one of the three for a given failure.
items.zh: 给定一种故障，从三者中选对的那一个。
